name: PropertyTable
purpose: Read-only tabular property comparison using native table semantics.

guidance.useWhen: Use when readers must compare properties across rows or columns and those relationships are genuinely tabular.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use DescriptionList for term-and-description facts; use UniversalDataGrid when sorting, filtering, resizing, selection, grouping, or grid state is required.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Treat PropertyTable as a state-free semantic wrapper around one real table, not as a data-grid or application-specific property model.

accessibility: Keep one native table as the semantic authority; preserve caption, th, scope, and header/cell relationships and do not replace them with grid roles.
requires exactly one native table element as projected content so table, row, column, header, and cell relationships remain browser semantics
the table should provide a caption or another accessible name when surrounding context does not already identify its purpose
header cells must use native th semantics with scope or explicit header associations appropriate to the table structure
responsive presentation may scroll or wrap but must not replace table semantics with generic or ARIA grid roles
knownLimitations: Avoid for interactive data-grid behavior such as sorting, filtering, resizing, selection, grouping, or persisted grid state; use UniversalDataGrid instead.
